text: Before 0.3.0 the reader searched for which columns were ragged, scored candidates by re-rendering, and had a brute-force backstop, stream retries and sampling, all so a parsed table could be re-rendered byte for byte. Commit 880c4c7 replaced that with a split on spaces, the last column taking the rest of the line, and 5bf9223 dropped what only re-rendering had kept. The reader gives back the data; it does not rebuild the writer's style.
